typeUri.description: Filter to rows of this kind: a registered predicate IRI (statements whose `credentialSubject.predicate` it is), or `role:vetter`.

subjectDid.description: Filter to endorsements about this subject.

includeRevoked.description: Include revoked rows. Defaults to true — both live and revoked rows surface; consumers filter on revokedAt.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

totalEstimate.description: Approximate total matching endorsements, when the maintainer can cheaply estimate it.
